decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [101 REV 04, 150 REV 04, unnumbered location plan, paint finish ral 6007, easy storage fire method statement, planning statement 
Received: 22/08/2025
Transport statement, draft construction logistics plan, 102 REV 02, 120 REV 02
Received: 20/03/2026].

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby approved shall be used for the storage of open containers (B8 storage and distribution) only and for no other purpose including any other purpose in Class B of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification

Reason: In order to protect the appearance of the area and in the interests of pedestrian and vehicle safety

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the submitted details and prior to occupation, full details (including manufacturer's specifications) of all cycle stands for the staff of, and visitors to, the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before any part of the development is first occupied and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.

Condition : 7 - The number of containers at the site shall not exceed 382 and shall not be laid out or stacked other than in accordance with the approved plans.

Reason
To accord with the terms of the application and in the interests of the area, highway and pedestrian safety
description: Change of use from Car Storage, use Class B8, to Open Self Storage, use Class B8, and the siting of 382 storage containers
